info.name: DIA — DronaPay Intelligent Agent
info.description:
Complete test collection for the DIA FastAPI service.

**Setup:**
1. Set `baseUrl` to your running instance (default: http://localhost:8000)
2. Set `username` / `password` to match REST_USER / REST_PWD in your .env
3. Set `tenantId` (seed data uses 17)
4. Run the **Setup** folder first to initialise collection variables

**Auth:** HTTP Basic is applied at collection level — all requests inherit it.

item.description:
POST /ingest_document

Returns {status: 'queued'} immediately. Actual processing runs in a background task — poll GET /document_status to track progress.

File sources:
- raw_text: plain text, processed directly
- file_content: base64-encoded binary, stored in agents.dms_file_content (no S3/GCS needed)
- storage_url: URL on ALLOWED_STORAGE_ORIGINS allowlist
